'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Herold LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Brian Harold
* '''Username:''' The Smoking Gungan
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
